about: Opens a panel attached to an edge of the window over a dimmed page, and keeps focus in it until the reader closes it. Escape, a press on the backdrop, the close button and an action button close it, and focus returns to the trigger.

contained.about: The panel against the edge, then `contained`, which insets it from the window and rounds its corners.
contained.title: Contained

filters.description: Show the invoices in the states you pick.
filters.title: Filter invoices

form.about: A form in the body with its submit button in the footer. Create task checks the title and keeps the drawer open with the error until the title is filled in.
form.title: Form

panel.about: A search field and recent searches in a panel at the top of the window. A recent search is an action trigger, so choosing one closes the panel.
panel.title: Top panel

placement.about: The panel at the inline start, at the inline end, at the top and at the bottom of the window. Start and end swap edges in a right-to-left document.
placement.title: Placements

sheet.about: Share options in a sheet at the bottom of the window. Each option is an action trigger, so choosing one closes the sheet.
sheet.title: Bottom sheet

size.about: The panel at 20, 28, 32, 42 and 56rem, then `full`, which fills the window. At the top and at the bottom the size is the panel's greatest height.
size.title: Sizes

title: Drawer
